company.name: Breez
company.shortDescription: Breez offers cloud identity threat detection and automated incident response for major platforms.
company.description: Breez develops tools for detecting, investigating, and responding to identity threats within cloud environments. The company’s solutions support platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, as well as SaaS applications including Office 365, Google Workspace, and Workday. Its software automates incident response workflows and enables one-click investigations to assist security teams in managing identity-related risks. Founded by a former chief information security officer, it focuses on providing practical solutions to address challenges in cloud identity security and streamline threat mitigation.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that detects compromised human and non-human identities and automates incident response using behavioral analytics.
productsAndServices.name: Breez Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR)

productsAndServices.description: A system that captures and tracks static and dynamic activity patterns of human and non-human identities in the cloud.
productsAndServices.name: Behavioral Identity Fingerprint

productsAndServices.description: A tool that manages and creates permissions based on actual usage data to enforce least privilege access.
productsAndServices.name: Usage-Based Entitlement Management

productsAndServices.description: A system that proactively detects attacks by monitoring changes in identity behavior in real-time.
productsAndServices.name: Continuous Attack Detection

productsAndServices.description: Tools that use identity context to streamline incident investigation and automate response workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Identity-Centric Investigation and Automated Workflows
